description.zh:
需要恢复的数据库名列表，多个数据库之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> 如不填任何数据库名称则默认恢复实例下所有数据库。
description.en:
The list of database names to restore. Separate multiple database names with commas (,).
> If you do not specify any database names, all databases in the instance are restored by default.

description.zh:
DRDS备份集ID。
> 若不填该参数，则默认按时间点（PreferredBackupTime）恢复。
description.en:
The ID of the DRDS backup set.
> If you do not specify this parameter, the restoration is performed based on the point in time specified by PreferredBackupTime.

description.zh:
备份级别，取值范围如下：
* db：数据库级别
* instance：实例级别
description.en:
The backup level. Valid values:

* db: database level
* instance: instance level.

description.zh:
备份方式，取值范围如下：
* logic：逻辑备份
* phy：快速备份
description.en:
The backup mode. Valid values:

* logic: logical backup
* phy: fast backup.
The instance ID of the DRDS instance.

description.zh: 实例的恢复时间，格式为`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`。
description.en: The restoration time of the instance. The value is in the `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss` format.

title.zh: 启动基于备份的恢复任务

example.unifiedCli: aliyun drds start-restore --drds-instance-id rds00000000 --preferred-backup-time 2019-09-10_20:18:18 --backup-mode phy --backup-level db --backup-db-names test1,test2 --backup-id 23000 --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun drds StartRestore --region cn-hangzhou --DrdsInstanceId rds00000000 --PreferredBackupTime '2019-09-10_20:18:18' --BackupMode phy --BackupLevel db --BackupDbNames 'test1,test2' --BackupId 23000
